whoItsFor: Teams and individual developers running multiple AI agents who want shared, governed memory (chat history, skills, docs, and code knowledge) that persists across agents and frameworks. Also suited to a one-person company building a squad of specialized agents.
useCases: Share Chat Memory, Skills, Wiki, and CodeGraph across a team of AI agents
Cold-start new agents from existing codebases, docs, and past conversation sessions
Equip role-specific agents (e.g., Reviewer, Builder) with only the memory assets they need
